name: witness
description: Keeps a ledger of what you asked for and counts it done only on evidence: claims stay pale until a read-back confirms them, bare SQL UPDATE or DELETE writes are held for your answer, and a print of what was and was not witnessed goes into the session log.

body.title: Body
body.description: The companion's body: naut (nautilus; the older name phi is still accepted) or phial (round-bottom flask).

watchHold.title: Hold the first prompt until the watch is taken
watchHold.description: On session start, and after five idle minutes, ask before the prompt goes through. Off by default.

ticketScript.title: Ticket script
ticketScript.description: Path of the script that prints a status ticket as JSON (relative to the session folder, or absolute). Empty: scripts/estate-status.py beside the mod, and no ticket when it is absent.

watchScript.title: Watch script
watchScript.description: Path of the script that reads the board for the watch and its poll. Empty: scripts/witness-watch.py in the mod's own repository, and no watch or poll when it is absent.

writerCalls.title: Writer calls
writerCalls.description: Comma-separated SQL functions a SELECT calls to write (schema.name; a trailing * matches any suffix). Default: none, so a SELECT is a read.

sqlTools.title: SQL tools
sqlTools.description: Comma-separated tool names of the database tools whose queries are held when an UPDATE or DELETE has no RETURNING; * matches any run of characters. Default: mcp__*__execute_sql, any MCP tool whose name ends __execute_sql.

tableSchemas.title: Table schemas
tableSchemas.description: Comma-separated schemas whose schema.table names in a subagent's report count as targets it named. Default: public.

person.title: Your name
person.description: How the print and the confirm tool name you. Default: you ("on your words"; the model reads "the user").

sessionsDir.title: Session log folder
sessionsDir.description: Where session logs live, relative to the session folder.

goalsHeading.title: Goals heading
goalsHeading.description: The session log heading whose checkbox items are the goals.

closeCommands.title: Close commands
closeCommands.description: Comma-separated commands that close a session; the print is written before they run.

sonar.title: Sonar
sonar.description: Heartbeats between running sessions, overlap alerts and /hand. auto: on where the ticket script is found; on; off. Writes small files under ~/.claude/state/witness-sonar.

typedHands.title: Typed hands
typedHands.description: Whether a /hand typed in another session starts work here without an Enter. auto: only where the ticket script is found; start; wait. A hand is taken on a plugin stamp that is the sender's own claim, so wait is the safe choice.

pointInTimeRecovery.title: Database has point-in-time recovery
pointInTimeRecovery.description: Whether a lost-rows SQL statement (DROP, TRUNCATE, an unpinned DELETE or UPDATE) can be got back by a point-in-time restore. On: the blush shows rung 2 (rim and walls). Off, or unknown: rung 3 (the top too), because unknown fails closed.

haemorrhageRows.title: Haemorrhage threshold (rows)
haemorrhageRows.description: An UPDATE or DELETE with RETURNING that sends back more rows than it named, and more than this, turns the whole creature red (HAEMORRHAGE). Display only.

lampTest.title: Lamp test at session start
lampTest.description: Show the whole creature red for 1.5 seconds when a session starts, to prove the red channel works.

effectTables.title: Effect tables
effectTables.description: Comma-separated tables whose writes can reach outside the database (a trigger that calls a webhook or build). A write to one is at least rung 2 on the blush; * matches any run of characters. Default: none, so the witness says the triggers are not in effectTables.
